figurative_meaning_en: to leave a lasting impression on the mind
example_sentences_in_bangla: তাঁর উপদেশ আমার মনে দাগ কেটেছে।
এই ঘটনা তার জীবনে চিরকালের জন্য দাগ কেটেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: His advice left a mark on my mind.
This incident has etched itself into his life forever.
note: The idiom draws from the imagery of physical scarring to metaphorically represent indelible mental impressions, common in Bengali expressive language.
